description: Fail-closed input and interpretation cases for external-validation calibration-slope synthesis.
required_invariants: one exact model identity and version
one outcome definition and time horizon
each calibration slope requires a source-reported standard error or confidence interval
calibration slopes are pooled on the original scale
a slope of one is ideal, a slope below one indicates predictions that are too extreme, and a slope above one indicates predictions that are not extreme enough
calibration slope alone does not establish calibration-in-the-large, discrimination, or clinical utility
